{"code":"
from pypdf import PdfReader

for year in ["2020", "2021"]:
    path = f"/online1/ycsc_chenkh/hitici_07/deepseek-harness/attached_files/task_49/ADOBE_{year}_10K.pdf"
    reader = PdfReader(path)
    print(f"=== {year}: {len(reader.pages)} pages ===")
    # find pages containing "Research and development"
    hits = []
    for i, page in enumerate(reader.pages):
        t = page.extract_text() or ""
        if "Research and development" in t:
            hits.append(i)
    print("pages with 'Research and development':", [h+1 for h in hits])
"}

| 2021 财年（截至 2021-12-03） | **$2,540 百万** | 2021 年 10-K，合并利润表（Consolidated Statements of Income），Operating expenses 项下 Research and development，第 56 页 |

## 二、同比增幅计算

**计算公式：**

\[
\text{同比增幅} = \frac{\text{2021年研发费用} - \text{2020年研发费用}}{\text{2020年研发费用}} \times 100\%
\]

**代入数值：**

\[
\frac{2{,}540 - 2{,}188}{2{,}188} \times 100\% = \frac{352}{2{,}188} \times 100\% = 16.09\% \approx 16.1\%
\]
